catalog_note: Static catalog (checked 2026-07). SHOW TABLES / DESCRIBE / information_schema are not supported by the data service; this list plus `SELECT * FROM <table> LIMIT 1` is the discovery path. Full details: data/SKILL.md.

catalog.description: Daily price and volume history for US stocks (open/high/low/close/volume). Prices as-traded, NOT split/dividend adjusted.
Minute-by-minute price and volume for US stocks. Very large - always filter by ticker and time window.
Company financial statements as filed with the SEC (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow), one row per company per reporting period.
Financial news articles: timestamp, headline, related tickers, full text. The only table searchable by meaning via /search.
Every stock split: ticker, effective date, and ratio. Needed to adjust raw prices across a split.
Every cash dividend: ex-dividend date, payment date, amount per share, payout frequency.
For each stock and day, how much of that day's trading volume came from short selling, by trading venue.
Total shares currently sold short per stock, reported twice a month, with days-to-cover.
Master list of every US ticker, listed or delisted, with exchange and identifiers. Use to build universes and join tables.
Companies going public: announcement and listing dates, offer price and size, offering status.
Daily price and volume history for China A-shares, with the cumulative adjustment factor for split/dividend-adjusted prices.
Minute-by-minute price and volume for China A-shares. Very large - filter by stock and time window.
Per-stock daily valuation and trading snapshot: price-to-earnings, price-to-book, turnover rate, market cap.
Quarterly/annual income statements of listed Chinese companies: revenue, costs, profit, earnings per share.
Balance sheets of listed Chinese companies: assets, liabilities, shareholder equity.
Cash-flow statements of listed Chinese companies: operating, investing, and financing cash flows.
Precomputed financial ratios per company per period: profitability, leverage, liquidity, growth.
For each stock and day, the net value of buying versus selling - money flowing into or out of the stock.
Exchanges' daily disclosure of stocks with unusual price moves or turnover: which stocks, why, and the net amount the most active trading desks bought or sold.
